chart_text: 58-year-old woman with 6-month history of bilateral wrist and MCP joint pain and swelling. Morning stiffness lasting more than 2 hours, improving by midday. RF positive (titer 1:320), anti-CCP strongly positive (>250 U/mL). ESR 68 mm/hr, CRP 3.2 mg/dL. Hand X-rays show periarticular osteopenia and early erosions at 2nd and 3rd MCPs bilaterally. No skin rash. No sicca symptoms.
notes: Classic seropositive RA with erosions

chart_text: 45-year-old man with 4-month progressive bilateral PIP and wrist arthritis. Synovial fluid aspirated from right wrist: WBC 18,000/mm3 with 72% PMNs, no crystals identified, gram stain negative, culture pending. RF positive (1:160), anti-CCP positive. ESR 55 mm/hr. No skin findings, no tophi, no psoriasis. Symmetric distribution.
notes: RA with inflammatory synovial fluid - exercises ontology synovial fluid content

chart_text: 38-year-old woman with 3-month symmetric arthritis involving both MCPs and wrists with 90-minute morning stiffness. RF negative, anti-CCP negative. MRI wrists shows bilateral bone marrow edema and synovitis at carpal joints. ESR 45 mm/hr, CRP 2.1 mg/dL. No psoriasis, no axial symptoms, no sicca symptoms, ANA negative.
notes: Seronegative RA - tests if RAG helps with atypical presentations

chart_text: 27-year-old woman with 3-month history of butterfly facial rash, oral ulcers, pleuritic chest pain, and bilateral small joint arthralgia. Anti-dsDNA antibody positive (titer 1:320). Complement C3 52 mg/dL (low), C4 8 mg/dL (low). 24-hour urine protein 1.8g. Urinalysis with red cell casts. CBC: WBC 3,200/mm3 on three separate occasions, platelets 98,000/mm3.
notes: Classic multi-system SLE meeting multiple criteria

chart_text: 29-year-old woman with joint pain, photosensitivity, and recurrent thrombocytopenia. ANA positive (1:640, speckled pattern). Sm antibody positive. False positive VDRL on two separate occasions confirmed with negative FTA-abs. Platelet nadir 62,000/mm3. Lupus anticoagulant positive. Normal complement. No renal involvement currently.

chart_text: 24-year-old woman with 2-month fatigue, joint pains, and bilateral peripheral edema. 24-hour urine protein 4.2g. Anti-dsDNA positive (1:640). C3 32 mg/dL, C4 4 mg/dL. Renal biopsy demonstrates diffuse proliferative glomerulonephritis (Class IV). Malar rash present. CBC normal.
notes: SLE with Class IV nephritis - exercises renal biopsy ontology content

chart_text: 62-year-old man presenting with acute severe pain and swelling of the left first metatarsophalangeal joint, onset overnight. Joint aspiration: monosodium urate crystals identified (needle-shaped, strongly negatively birefringent under polarized light microscopy). Serum uric acid 9.8 mg/dL. WBC 14,000/mm3. No prior joint episodes. BMI 31.
notes: Classic gout - exercises crystal identification ontology content

chart_text: 55-year-old man with 3-year history of recurrent acute joint flares in wrists and knees. X-rays show chondrocalcinosis of both knee menisci and bilateral wrist triangular fibrocartilage. Serum calcium 11.2 mg/dL (elevated). PTH markedly elevated. Synovial fluid from knee: WBC 28,000/mm3 with weakly positively birefringent rhomboid crystals. Serum uric acid normal.
notes: CPPD/pseudogout with hyperparathyroidism - exercises hyperparathyroidism and chondrocalcinosis ontology content; not in 6-label set

chart_text: 48-year-old man with 5-year history of plaque psoriasis presenting with inflammatory arthritis affecting distal interphalangeal joints bilaterally. Nail pitting and onycholysis present. Dactylitis of right ring finger. RF negative, anti-CCP negative. X-rays: periostitis and asymmetric joint space narrowing at DIPs.
notes: Classic psoriatic arthritis with DIP and dactylitis

chart_text: 35-year-old man with 5-year history of plaque psoriasis now developing inflammatory low back pain worse at night, improving with exercise. Imaging shows non-marginal asymmetric syndesmophytes at L3-L5 and asymmetric sacroiliitis on MRI. HLA-B27 positive. RF negative, anti-CCP negative. No peripheral joint swelling.
notes: Axial psoriatic arthritis - exercises syndesmophyte pattern ontology content (non-marginal vs marginal)

chart_text: 24-year-old man with 3-year history of morning low back stiffness and night pain waking him from sleep, both improving with exercise and movement. MRI shows bilateral symmetric sacroiliitis with subchondral bone marrow edema. X-ray thoracolumbar junction: thin vertical marginal syndesmophytes bilaterally. HLA-B27 positive. ESR 38 mm/hr.
notes: AS - exercises marginal syndesmophyte and symmetric sacroiliitis ontology content

chart_text: 29-year-old man presenting with acute painful red right eye with photophobia and blurred vision. Slit lamp examination confirms acute anterior uveitis with cells and flare in anterior chamber. History of 2-year inflammatory low back pain with morning stiffness greater than 1 hour improving with movement, alternating buttock pain. HLA-B27 positive.
notes: AS with acute anterior uveitis - exercises iridocyclitis-AS link in ontology

chart_text: 67-year-old woman with 6-week bilateral shoulder and hip girdle pain and profound morning stiffness, unable to raise arms above shoulder height. ESR 82 mm/hr, CRP 4.8 mg/dL. RF negative, ANA negative, CK normal. Prednisone 15mg/day initiated with dramatic symptom improvement within 48 hours. No headache, no jaw claudication, no visual symptoms.
notes: Classic PMR with steroid response - exercises favorable response to treatment ontology content

chart_text: 71-year-old man with 8-week bilateral proximal shoulder and hip girdle aching and stiffness, 2-hour morning stiffness. ESR 74 mm/hr, CRP 5.1 mg/dL. CK normal. No skin findings. No headache, no temporal tenderness, no jaw symptoms, no visual disturbance. Responded dramatically to prednisone 20mg within 72 hours.
notes: PMR without GCA features

chart_text: 28-year-old man with asymmetric oligoarthritis of right knee and left ankle developing 3 weeks after an episode of bloody diarrhea confirmed as Salmonella enteritidis on stool culture. Also reporting recent urethral discharge. Mild bilateral conjunctivitis. HLA-B27 positive. RF negative, anti-CCP negative, ANA negative.
notes: Reactive/Reiter arthritis - DXREI not in 6-label set; tests specificity

chart_text: 68-year-old woman with acute swollen painful right knee. Synovial fluid aspiration: WBC 24,000/mm3 with 80% PMNs. Crystal analysis under polarized microscopy shows rhomboid crystals with weak positive birefringence (calcium pyrophosphate deposition). X-rays both knees: chondrocalcinosis of menisci. Serum uric acid 4.2 mg/dL (normal). No tophi.
notes: CPPD pseudogout - not gout despite acute monoarthritis; tests crystal differentiation

chart_text: 42-year-old woman with 18-month history of widespread musculoskeletal pain, profound fatigue, and non-restorative sleep. Tender points elicited at 14 of 18 classic fibromyalgia anatomical sites on examination. No synovitis. ESR 12 mm/hr, CRP normal, CBC normal, TSH normal. ANA negative, RF negative, anti-CCP negative.
notes: Fibromyalgia - exercises tender points ontology content; should not be labelled as inflammatory arthritis

chart_text: 55-year-old man on hydralazine for hypertension for 3 years presenting with polyarthritis, pleuritis, and fatigue over past 2 months. ANA positive (1:160, homogeneous pattern). Antihistone antibodies strongly positive. Anti-dsDNA negative. Complement C3 and C4 normal. No nephritis, no cytopenia, no renal involvement.
notes: Drug-induced lupus - not SLE; tests ANA pattern specificity and importance of antihistone vs anti-dsDNA

chart_text: 38-year-old woman with acute bilateral ankle arthritis and tender nodular lesions over both shins (erythema nodosum). Chest X-ray: bilateral hilar lymphadenopathy. Serum ACE elevated at 88 U/L. ESR 56 mm/hr. RF negative. Joint aspiration from ankle: WBC 1,200/mm3 (non-inflammatory). Spontaneous resolution over 6 weeks.

chart_text: 34-year-old woman with 5-week bilateral wrist and MCP joint arthritis. Morning stiffness 45 minutes. RF negative, anti-CCP negative, ANA negative. ESR 32 mm/hr, CRP 1.4 mg/dL.
